description:
*I started living alone with my crush.*

Lee Tae-Eun, who started living alone as he had always wanted to due to his parents' sudden overseas assignment. However, his joy was short-lived, as he found out that his roommate was Cha Jin-Heon, and he wanted to avoid him at all costs. Jin-Heon was his long-time crush and a childhood friend who had unilaterally cut ties with him. Tae-Eun, who impulsively confessed to him while drunk three years ago but was frustrated when it didn't reach his heart at all and went into hiding, is now in a difficult situation after their unexpected reunion. He begins living together with Jin-Heon without any particular plan, but Jin-Heon is very angry at Tae-Eun and is not easy. He even set a rule of living together that they should never interact privately. And Tae-Eun, who is trying to persuade Jin-Heon in any way, faces difficult days ahead...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
